item.title: Version 0.18.2
item.description:
### App
- Settings ▸ Browsers has a new Add to Firefox… button for installing the Cloud Anchor extension, with the steps to follow. (#2305)
### CLI
- Tab completes `anchor` commands, plus session IDs and names after session commands such as `anchor session start`. The completion scripts ship inside the app, in `CloudAnchor.app/Contents/Resources/completions/` for zsh, bash and fish; the README and the CLI guide show the one-line setup. (#2271, #2272) - The audit log now lives in `~/Library/Application Support/Cloud Anchor/audit/`. An existing log moves there the next time the app starts. (#2275, #2276) - `anchor audit list` now says macOS denied access to the audit log (`audit_log_access_denied`) when that is what happened, and no longer blames the signature for other read failures. (#2273) - An `aws` call that uses an IAM user session’s long-term keys now fails if Cloud Anchor can’t record the hand-out in its audit log, such as on a full disk, instead of handing out the keys unrecorded. (#2277)

item.title: Version 0.18.1
item.description:
### App
- Settings now has a sidebar and stays one size on every pane, so the window no longer jumps between sizes and General no longer leaves empty space. (#2268)

item.title: Version 0.18.0
item.description:
### App
- Settings is redesigned around six tabs: General, Integrations, Credentials, Profiles, Regions and Browsers. They share one width, and the window resizes to fit each tab. Settings reopens on the tab you last used, and links in the app open the tab they name. (#2205, #2206, #2207, #2208, #2209, #2235) - Integrations now live in Settings. The Integrations tab lists your IAM Identity Center integrations and SAML identity providers. It shows each one's sign-in state, with Stay signed in and Sign in at launch as checkboxes, and its + menu adds either kind. The Integrations toolbar button and menu items open this tab, and the separate Integrations window is gone. (#2211, #2212, #2213, #2215, #2216) - VoiceOver now names the buttons in Settings ▸ Credentials by what they do. (#2243)

item.title: Version 0.17.4
item.description:
### Install
- New Firefox extension that opens each AWS session in its own Firefox container. Install it from https://dbagan.github.io/cloud-anchor-updates/firefox/cloud-anchor-0.0.1.xpi; Firefox then keeps it up to date. (#265)

item.title: Version 0.17.2
item.description:
### App
- A lease longer than AWS allows for its role now says so, instead of blaming the role's trust policy. (#2178)
### CLI
- New `anchor lease status <lease-id>` shows a lease and, once it has ended, why: denied, revoked, expired, or refused by AWS. `--output json` carries the reason as `endReason`. (#2177) - `anchor lease request --wait` now waits until the lease is ready to use, so a lease AWS refuses to issue exits 6 with its reason instead of reporting success. (#2186)

item.title: Version 0.17.1
item.description:
### App
- **Security:** a lease that names AWS managed policies is now limited to those policies, as the approval sheet shows; before, its region and service limits didn't hold beside them and the session's role could grant more. A lease that combines a custom policy document with managed policies is now refused. (#2169) - Leases on a chained role session now work without the role having to trust itself. A federated or Identity Center lease that AWS refuses now says the role must trust itself, or to lease from a chained role instead. (#2172) - The lease approval sheet now says correctly that a region-limited lease can reach global services such as IAM only when us-east-1 is one of its regions. (#2166)
### CLI
- `anchor lease request` works right after `anchor session add`; before, the app could refuse it for up to 30 seconds. (#2171) - `anchor session status` no longer prints control characters from the caller identity or from an AWS error code. (#2160, #2164)

item.title: Version 0.17.0
item.description:
### App
- Choose which AWS regions appear in menus and pickers. The Region menus list your shortlist, with the rest under More, and Settings has a new Regions section to pick them. (#2095) - More errors now say what happened and what to do instead of "Something went wrong": a file lock that fails, a missing home folder, a session value an AWS file can’t hold, and an `anchor session instances` listing that AWS refuses. (#2065, #2151) - The Relaunch and Install and Relaunch buttons are now the standard default button instead of red. (#2041)

item.title: Version 0.16.1
item.description:
### App
- Signing in to IAM Identity Center now finishes in your browser, with no code to type. When the browser can’t be used, or you click Use a Code Instead, the alert shows a code as before and says why. (#1266, #2097)
### CLI
- `anchor session status` no longer prints control characters from a role ARN. (#2128)

item.title: Version 0.16.0
item.description:
### App
- Deleting an IAM Identity Center integration while it is still syncing no longer leaves sessions behind for the deleted integration. (#2109)

item.title: Version 0.15.2
item.description:
### App
- When AWS ends an IAM Identity Center sign-in before it expires, the app and the CLI now say "Signed out by AWS" instead of asking you to sign in with no reason given. (#1680)

item.title: Version 0.15.1
item.description:
### Internal
- The release pipeline can now publish the signed Sparkle update feed: the appcast step failed on the first real run because it compared the signed item byte for byte, and `scripts/release/rerun-appcast` publishes the feed for an already-released version without rebuilding. (#2089)
